title: 🗣️ حوار التوازن الرقمي وضوابط الشاشات (Digital Detox Dialogue - SB Page 45)
description: 💡 حوار بين حازم (Hazem) و ياسر (Yasser) حول وضع حدود واضحة (Set Boundaries) لتقليل القلق الناتج عن وسائل التواصل والاستمتاع بحياة واقعية مرضية (Fulfilling Leisure Life).

turns.speaker: 📱 Hazem (حازم)
turns.en: Hey Yasser, I noticed you were not online yesterday evening. Did your phone run out of battery?

turns.speaker: 🌿 Yasser (ياسر)
turns.en: No, Hazem. I decided to step away from screens and set clear boundaries around my evening hours.

turns.speaker: 📱 Hazem (حازم)
turns.en: Really? Was it because of that research report on screen time and teenage anxiety?

turns.speaker: 🌿 Yasser (ياسر)
turns.en: Exactly. The report showed that constant comparison on social media damages self-esteem and interferes with sleep.

turns.speaker: 📱 Hazem (حازم)
turns.en: That makes total sense. And what did you do instead of scrolling and gaming?

turns.speaker: 🌿 Yasser (ياسر)
turns.en: I went cycling in the park with friends and read a great book. It was truly fulfilling and restored my mental focus.

turns.speaker: 📱 Hazem (حازم)
turns.en: You inspired me! I will start setting screen-free hours every day to protect my well-being too.
